$comment: Generated by scripts/schemas from trialfolio.contracts.attempt.StartRecordV1_2, in serialization mode. Validation and serialization modes give the same schema. Never edit it by hand.

Exchange.description:
One HTTP exchange the wrapper made through Trial Folio's transport adapter (HTTP
exchanges). Nothing else about it is kept: no headers, tokens, bodies, or exceptions.

request.description: The method and path, such as `POST /auth` or `POST /screen/backtest`.
request.title: Request

status.description: The HTTP status of a `response`; null otherwise.
status.title: Status

note.description:
Set only on a restarted attempt's request exchange, recorded as a 200 because its response
was found saved (uncertain completion); null otherwise.
note.title: Note

Exchange.title: Exchange

TransportVersions.description: The installed `requests` and `urllib3`, which carry the wrapper's requests.
TransportVersions.title: TransportVersions

WrapperVersions.description: The installed `p123api`, which sends the requests (plan contents).
WrapperVersions.title: WrapperVersions

description:
A start record 1.2.0: a screen run's attempt that sends a definition, or a snapshot's.
It's written durably just before its send: the update record, `updating.json`, before the
`rank_update`, and `started.json` before the backtest, or before a snapshot's `rank_get`.

case_id.description: The case; null for a snapshot's attempt, which plans no case.
case_id.title: Case Id

plan_hash.description: The plan the attempt runs under.
plan_hash.title: Plan Hash

exchanges.description:
Trial Folio's successful authentication, and in `started.json` before a backtest, the
`rank_update`'s exchange, `POST /rank` with a 200.
exchanges.title: Exchanges

title: StartRecordV1_2
